summary_en: ENEOS Holdings will cancel 39,633,900 treasury shares on October 16, 2026, representing 1.5% of issued shares before cancellation. The shares were acquired between May 21 and September 15, 2026 for a total of ¥50.0 billion via market purchase under a discretionary investment agreement.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
ENEOS Holdings resolved at a board meeting on September 28, 2026 to cancel 39,633,900 treasury shares, representing 1.5% of shares outstanding before cancellation, on October 16, 2026. This action implements a prior board resolution from May 14, 2026, which authorized both the acquisition and subsequent cancellation of the treasury shares.

The shares were acquired between May 21 and September 15, 2026 through market purchases under a discretionary investment agreement. The total acquisition cost was ¥49,999,884,750, or approximately ¥1,261 per share. Following the cancellation, ENEOS Holdings will have 2,667,132,649 shares outstanding.
